tensions: Dawn and Noon see a clean book - 7 of 8 green, no stop triggered, LINK carrying a dated institutional catalyst on September 16. Close and Night see a portfolio with zero dry powder ($1.87, not the $46.60 on file) entering a market where sentiment reads Greed at 71 while total market cap falls 3.3% in a day. The unresolved question is not what to sell - nothing qualifies - but whether being 99.9% deployed into an Altcoin Season Index of 44 is conviction or complacency. Any move before the Arc launch requires a deposit, not a rotation.

opening.text: Book is $1,393 against $1,086 deposited - up 28.3%, and every name except NEAR is green. LINK is the story: Circle's Arc mainnet goes live September 16 with Chainlink as the official oracle partner, founding validators including BlackRock, DTCC and Visa. We hold 38 LINK at an $11.73 average, now $12.91, and the catalyst has not even fired yet. DOT ripped 13% in a day with issuance cut 53% by the March supply cap. ZEC +21.8% in four days. This is what letting winners run looks like.

Numbers first. LINK +10.1% (9d), ZEC +21.8% (4d), DOT +19.0% (3d), SOL +11.6% (22d), LTC +6.7%, AAVE +5.2%, ADA +2.2%, NEAR -6.1% (1d). Zero sell triggers fired: nothing near the -15% stop, no unlocks inside seven days, BTC dominance at 59.1% is under the 60% kill-switch, and no position is 14-day dead money. Correction to the record: the scan file lists $46.60 buying power. Robinhood reports $1.87. A $46.60 LINK order preview was rejected outright for insufficient funds. We are fully deployed, whether or not that was intentional.

Read the tape, not the tally. Total crypto market cap is down 3.3% over 24 hours while Fear and Greed prints 71 - sentiment running ahead of price is how tops are built, not bottoms. BTC is $78,903 and slipping. The Altcoin Season Index sits in the mid-40s; it needs 75 to mean anything. Dominance was rejected at 60%, but 59.1% is not a rotation, it is a rounding error. Half this book's gains are three days old. Unrealized is a story the market can revise overnight.

The uncomfortable question: is this skill or beta? Eight alts up 28% in a month, in a market where BTC dominance never left the high fifties, is not obviously alpha - it is leverage to a bounce. DOT's 13% day was a short squeeze that liquidated $610K, not adoption. NEAR was bought yesterday at $2.4534 straight into the $2.30-2.40 resistance band and is already red; an entry-timing problem, not a thesis problem, but a problem. And with $1.87 in cash there is no optionality left. If LINK's Arc launch on the 16th sells the news, we watch it happen with empty hands.
